items.description: Core libraries and frameworks used to build, train, and run AI and machine learning systems.

children.title: TensorFlow
children.description: End-to-end platform with excellent production deployment, TPU support, and large-scale serving tools.

children.title: PyTorch
children.description: Dynamic computation graphs, Pythonic API, dominant in research and production. The current standard for most frontier AI work.

children.title: Keras
children.description: High-level, beginner-friendly API that now runs on multiple backends (TensorFlow, JAX, PyTorch). Perfect for rapid experimentation.

children.title: timm (PyTorch Image Models)
children.description: The largest collection of PyTorch image encoders and backbones. 900+ pretrained models including ResNet, EfficientNet, Vision Transformer, ConvNeXt, and more with training and inference scripts. Apache 2.0 licensed.

children.title: JAX
children.description: High-performance numerical computing with composable transformations (JIT, vmap, grad). Rising favorite for research and scientific ML.

children.title: tinygrad
children.description: Minimalist deep learning framework with tiny code footprint. The "you like PyTorch? you like micrograd? you love tinygrad!" philosophy - simple yet powerful.

children.title: MLX
children.description: Array framework for machine learning on Apple silicon. Efficient unified memory design with NumPy-like API, automatic differentiation, and multi-device support. MIT licensed.

children.title: vit-pytorch
children.description: Comprehensive Vision Transformer (ViT) implementations in PyTorch. Reference implementations of all major vision transformer variants including ViT, DeiT, Swin, and more. MIT licensed.

children.title: PaddlePaddle
children.description: Industrial deep learning platform from Baidu serving 23+ million developers and 760,000+ companies. China's first independent R&D framework with advanced distributed training and deployment capabilities.

children.title: PyTorch Geometric
children.description: Library for deep learning on irregular input data such as graphs, point clouds, and manifolds. Part of the PyTorch ecosystem.

children.title: Triton
children.description: Language and compiler for writing highly efficient custom deep-learning primitives. Powers kernel optimizations in PyTorch, JAX, and other frameworks. MIT licensed.

children.title: GGML
children.description: Tensor library for machine learning. The foundational C/C++ library powering llama.cpp and many on-device inference engines. MIT licensed.

children.title: Flax
children.description: Neural network library for JAX, designed for flexibility. Apache-2.0 licensed.

children.title: dm-haiku
children.description: JAX-based neural network library from Google DeepMind. Elegant functional API with state management, widely used in DeepMind's research. Apache 2.0 licensed.

children.title: Equinox
children.description: Elegant easy-to-use neural networks and scientific computing in JAX. Callable PyTrees with filtered transformations, seamless interoperability with the JAX ecosystem. Apache 2.0 licensed.

children.title: NumPyro
children.description: Probabilistic programming with NumPy powered by JAX for autograd and JIT compilation. Bayesian modeling and inference at scale.

children.title: Diffrax
children.description: Numerical differential equation solvers in JAX. Autodifferentiable and GPU-capable ODE/SDE/CDE solvers for scientific machine learning and neural differential equations. Apache 2.0 licensed.

children.title: Modular Platform
children.description: Open-source AI compute and programming platform built around the MAX Engine and Mojo programming language.

children.title: ONNX
children.description: Open standard for machine learning interoperability. Open Neural Network Exchange provides an open ecosystem that empowers AI developers to choose the right tools as their project evolves. Apache 2.0 licensed.

children.title: oneDNN
children.description: oneAPI Deep Neural Network Library. Cross-platform performance library of basic building blocks for deep learning, optimized for Intel CPUs, GPUs, and Arm architectures. Apache 2.0 licensed.

children.title: IREE
children.description: Retargetable MLIR-based machine learning compiler and runtime toolkit. Lowers ML models to unified IR that scales from datacenter to mobile and edge deployments. Apache 2.0 licensed.

children.title: Candle (Hugging Face)
children.description: Minimalist ML framework for Rust. PyTorch-like API with focus on performance and simplicity.

children.title: Burn
children.description: Next-generation deep learning framework in Rust. Backend-agnostic with CPU, GPU, WebAssembly support.

children.title: linfa
children.description: Comprehensive Rust ML toolkit with classical algorithms. scikit-learn equivalent for Rust with clustering, regression, and preprocessing.

children.title: Flux.jl
children.description: 100% pure-Julia ML stack with lightweight abstractions on top of native GPU and AD support. Elegant, hackable, and fully integrated with Julia's scientific computing ecosystem.

children.title: MLJ.jl
children.description: Comprehensive Julia machine learning framework providing a unified interface to 200+ models with meta-algorithms for selection, tuning, and evaluation. MIT licensed.

children.title: ModelingToolkit.jl
children.description: High-performance symbolic-numeric modeling framework for scientific machine learning. Automatically generates fast functions for model components like Jacobians and Hessians with automatic sparsification and parallelization. MIT licensed.

children.title: Transformers (Hugging Face)
children.description: The de facto standard library for pretrained NLP models. 1M+ models, 250,000+ downloads/day. BERT, GPT, Llama, Qwen, and hundreds more.

children.title: spaCy (Explosion AI)
children.description: Industrial-strength natural language processing with 75+ languages, transformer pipelines, and production-grade NER, parsing, and text classification.

children.title: sentence-transformers
children.description: Classic library for sentence and image embeddings.

children.title: LibreTranslate
children.description: Self-hosted machine translation API powered by the Argos Translate engine. AGPL-3.0 licensed.

children.title: tokenizers (Hugging Face)
children.description: Fast state-of-the-art tokenizers for training and inference.

children.title: fairseq2
children.description: FAIR Sequence Modeling Toolkit 2. Complete rewrite of fairseq with modern PyTorch APIs, native support for LLM training (70B+ models), vLLM integration, and first-party recipes for instruction finetuning and preference optimization. MIT licensed.

children.title: uv
children.description: An extremely fast Python package and project manager, written in Rust. 10-100x faster than pip with built-in virtual environment management, dependency resolution, and lockfiles. Essential for modern AI/ML development workflows. Apache 2.0 and MIT dual-licensed.

children.title: Scrapy
children.description: Fast, high-level web crawling and scraping framework for Python. Extract structured data from websites at scale with built-in support for handling common challenges like pagination, cookies, and concurrent requests. BSD-3-Clause licensed.

children.title: Pandas
children.description: The gold standard for data analysis and manipulation in Python.

children.title: Apache Airflow
children.description: Platform to programmatically author, schedule, and monitor workflows. Industry-standard orchestration for data pipelines and ML workflows with 500+ integrations. Apache 2.0 licensed.

children.title: Apache Spark
children.description: Unified analytics engine for large-scale data processing. In-memory cluster computing with high-level APIs in Python, Scala, Java, and R. Powers MLlib for distributed machine learning and Structured Streaming for real-time data. Apache 2.0 licensed.

children.title: DuckDB
children.description: High-performance analytical in-process SQL database system. Fast, reliable, portable, and easy to use with rich SQL dialect support. Perfect for data processing and analytics workloads. MIT licensed.

children.title: Polars
children.description: Blazing-fast DataFrame library (Rust backend) - modern alternative to Pandas for large-scale workloads.

children.title: NumPy
children.description: Fundamental array computing library that powers almost every AI stack.

children.title: Label Studio
children.description: Multi-type data labeling and annotation tool with standardized output format. Configurable interface for images, text, audio, video, and time series with ML-assisted labeling. Apache 2.0 licensed.

children.title: Apache Flink
children.description: Stream processing framework with powerful batch and streaming capabilities. High-throughput, low-latency runtime with exactly-once processing guarantees. Ideal for real-time AI inference pipelines and event-driven ML applications. Apache 2.0 licensed.

children.title: Temporal
children.description: Durable execution platform for reliable workflow orchestration. Build resilient data pipelines and ML workflows that survive failures and continue execution exactly where they left off. MIT licensed.

children.title: Vector
children.description: A high-performance observability data pipeline for collecting, transforming, and routing logs and metrics. Real-time data processing with 50+ sources and sinks including Kafka, S3, and Elasticsearch. Ideal for AI/ML log processing and data ingestion. MPL 2.0 licensed.

children.title: Luigi
children.description: Python module for building complex pipelines of batch jobs. Handles dependency resolution, workflow management, visualization, and Hadoop integration. Built at Spotify and battle-tested in production. Apache 2.0 licensed.

children.title: NetworkX
children.description: Creation, manipulation, and study of complex networks. The foundational graph analysis library for Python data science.

children.title: SciPy
children.description: Scientific computing algorithms (optimization, linear algebra, statistics, signal processing).

children.title: Dask
children.description: Parallel computing for big data - scales Pandas/NumPy/scikit-learn to clusters.

children.title: CuPy
children.description: NumPy and SciPy-compatible array library for GPU-accelerated computing in Python.

children.title: FiftyOne
children.description: Visual AI development toolkit for visualizing, labeling, and evaluating visual datasets and models. Supercharges computer vision workflows with dataset exploration and model analysis. Apache 2.0 licensed.

children.title: cuDF
children.description: GPU DataFrame library from RAPIDS. Accelerates Pandas workflows on NVIDIA GPUs with zero code changes using cuDF.pandas accelerator mode.

children.title: Apache Iceberg
children.description: High-performance open table format for huge analytic tables. Brings SQL table reliability to big data with time travel, hidden partitioning, and schema evolution. Works with Spark, Trino, Flink, Presto, Hive and Impala. Apache 2.0 licensed.

children.title: Delta Lake
children.description: Open-source storage framework enabling Lakehouse architecture with ACID transactions, scalable metadata handling, and unified batch/streaming processing. Apache 2.0 licensed.

children.title: Mage.ai
children.description: Modern open-source data pipeline tool for integrating and transforming data. AI-native ETL/ELT platform with 100+ integrations, real-time monitoring, and collaborative features. Apache 2.0 licensed.

children.title: Apache Beam
children.description: Unified programming model for batch and streaming data processing. Write pipelines once, run anywhere on Flink, Spark, or Google Cloud Dataflow. Portable, extensible, and enterprise-ready for AI data pipelines. Apache 2.0 licensed.

children.title: Vaex
children.description: Out-of-Core hybrid Apache Arrow/NumPy DataFrame for Python. Visualize and explore billion-row datasets at millions of rows per second. MIT licensed.

children.title: DataFlow
children.description: LLM-ready data preparation system for turning raw PDFs, conversations, code, databases, and other sources into SFT, QA, and RAG-ready datasets.

children.title: Ibis
children.description: Portable Python dataframe library with 20+ backends. Write Pandas-like code that runs locally with DuckDB or scales to production databases (BigQuery, Snowflake, PostgreSQL) by changing one line. Apache 2.0 licensed.

children.title: Apache Hudi
children.description: Open data lakehouse platform for ingesting, indexing, storing, serving, transforming and managing data across cloud environments. Supports upserts, deletes and incremental processing on big data with built-in ingestion tools for Spark and Flink. Apache 2.0 licensed.

children.title: Snorkel
children.description: System for quickly generating training data with weak supervision. Programmatically label, build, and manage training data using labeling functions and probabilistic consensus models. Powers Snorkel Flow and used by Google, Apple, and Intel. Apache 2.0 licensed.

children.title: NVIDIA DALI
children.description: GPU-accelerated data loading and augmentation library with highly optimized building blocks for deep learning applications. Apache 2.0 licensed.

children.title: lakeFS
children.description: Data version control for your data lake that transforms object storage into Git-like repositories. Enables atomic, versioned data lake operations with branching, committing, and merging for data pipelines. Apache 2.0 licensed.

children.title: D-Tale
children.description: Visualizer for Pandas data structures with a Flask back-end and React front-end. Interactive data exploration with charting, filtering, and code export. LGPL-2.1 licensed.

children.title: Pandera
children.description: Statistical data testing and validation for dataframes. Pydantic-like API for Pandas, Polars, and other dataframe libraries with type hints and lazy validation. MIT licensed.

children.title: Datashader
children.description: High-performance large data visualization. Renders billions of points interactively without aggregation artifacts. BSD-3-Clause licensed.

children.title: TextAttack
children.description: Python framework for adversarial attacks, data augmentation, and model training in NLP. Augment datasets to increase model robustness and generate adversarial examples. MIT licensed.

children.title: Sweetviz
children.description: Beautiful, high-density visualizations for exploratory data analysis in two lines of code. Self-contained HTML reports for dataset comparison and target analysis. MIT licensed.

children.title: Hamilton
children.description: Declarative dataflow framework for building testable, modular, self-documenting data pipelines. Encode lineage and metadata directly in Python functions. Originally from Stitch Fix, now Apache incubating. Apache 2.0 licensed.

children.title: cuGraph
children.description: GPU graph analytics library with NetworkX-compatible API. 10-100x faster than CPU for large-scale graph algorithms. Apache 2.0 licensed.

children.title: Zarr
children.description: Chunked, compressed, N-dimensional array storage. Scalable tensor data format optimized for cloud and parallel computing. MIT licensed.

children.title: Narwhals
children.description: Lightweight compatibility layer between DataFrame libraries. Write Polars-like code that works seamlessly across Pandas, Polars, cuDF, Modin, and more. MIT licensed.

children.title: skrub
children.description: Machine learning with dataframes for dirty categorical data. Preprocessing and feature engineering for heterogeneous data with seamless Pandas/Polars integration. BSD-3-Clause licensed.

children.title: Oxen
children.description: Lightning fast data version control for machine learning. Optimized for large datasets with efficient diffing, branching, and collaboration. Apache 2.0 licensed.

children.title: scikit-learn
children.description: Industry-standard library for traditional machine learning (classification, regression, clustering, pipelines).

children.title: XGBoost
children.description: Scalable, high-performance gradient boosting library. Still dominates Kaggle and tabular competitions.

children.title: LightGBM
children.description: Microsoft's ultra-fast gradient boosting framework, optimized for speed and memory.

children.title: sktime
children.description: Unified framework for machine learning with time series. scikit-learn compatible API for forecasting, classification, clustering, and anomaly detection.

children.title: Darts
children.description: User-friendly forecasting and anomaly detection for time series. Unifies classical statistical models (ARIMA, ETS) with modern neural networks (N-BEATS, TFT, DeepAR) in a single scikit-learn compatible API. Apache 2.0 licensed.

children.title: CatBoost
children.description: Gradient boosting that handles categorical features natively with great out-of-the-box performance.

children.title: cuML
children.description: GPU-accelerated machine learning algorithms with scikit-learn compatible API. 10-50x faster than CPU implementations for large datasets. Apache 2.0 licensed.

children.title: SynapseML
children.description: Distributed machine learning on Apache Spark. Scalable, composable APIs for text analytics, vision, anomaly detection with seamless Python/Scala/R/.NET integration. MIT licensed.

children.title: PyTorch Forecasting
children.description: Time series forecasting with PyTorch. Multiple neural architectures (N-BEATS, TFT, DeepAR) with in-built interpretation capabilities, built on PyTorch Lightning for distributed training. MIT licensed.

children.title: StatsForecast
children.description: Lightning-fast statistical forecasting with ARIMA, ETS, CES, and Theta models. Optimized for high-performance time series workloads.

children.title: MLForecast
children.description: Scalable machine learning for time series forecasting. Train any sklearn-compatible model on millions of time series with efficient feature engineering. Apache 2.0 licensed.

children.title: OpenMetadata
children.description: Unified metadata platform for data discovery, observability, and governance. Column-level lineage, semantic search, and team collaboration with 70+ data service connectors. Apache 2.0 licensed.

children.title: DataHub
children.description: The #1 open-source metadata platform for data and AI. Data discovery, governance, and observability with 80+ connectors, column-level lineage, and AI assistant integration. Originally built at LinkedIn. Apache 2.0 licensed.

children.title: Amundsen
children.description: Data discovery and metadata engine from Lyft. PageRank-style search for data resources with usage-based ranking. LF AI & Data Foundation project. Apache 2.0 licensed.

children.title: WrenAI
children.description: Open-source Generative BI engine and context layer for AI agents to query databases and produce trusted SQL and dashboards. Apache 2.0 licensed.

children.title: dbt-core
children.description: Transform data using software engineering best practices. The industry-standard framework for analytics engineering with 15M+ monthly downloads. Enables version control, testing, and documentation for SQL transformations. Apache 2.0 licensed.

children.title: SQLMesh
children.description: Scalable and efficient data transformation framework with dbt compatibility. Features automatic data lineage, time travel, and virtual data environments for testing. Optimized for large-scale data warehouses. Apache 2.0 licensed.

children.title: Apache Ossie
children.description: Vendor-neutral specification to standardize semantic models across analytics, BI, and AI agent platforms. Apache 2.0 licensed.

children.title: SLayer
children.description: Semantic layer for AI-powered data analytics. Allows AI agents to describe data models and query the data using an expressive format with measures, dimensions, and filters, without writing raw SQL. MCP, CLI, API, and Python clients. Embeddable as a Python library. MIT licensed.

children.title: ydata-profiling
children.description: One line of code for comprehensive data quality profiling and exploratory data analysis. Generates detailed reports for Pandas and Spark DataFrames including statistics, correlations, missing values, and data quality alerts. MIT licensed.

children.title: Great Expectations
children.description: Always know what to expect from your data. Data validation, profiling, and documentation for data pipelines. Apache 2.0 licensed.

children.title: Deequ
children.description: Library built on top of Apache Spark for defining "unit tests for data". Measures data quality in large datasets with constraint verification, anomaly detection, and incremental validation. Used at Amazon for production data quality. Apache 2.0 licensed.

children.title: Soda Core
children.description: Data contracts engine for the modern data stack. Define data quality checks in YAML and automatically validate schema and data across your pipelines. Supports 20+ data sources including Snowflake, BigQuery, and PostgreSQL. Apache 2.0 licensed.

children.title: TFX (TensorFlow Extended)
children.description: End-to-end platform for deploying production ML pipelines. Data validation, transformation, model training, and serving with TensorFlow. Powers Google's production ML infrastructure. Apache 2.0 licensed.

children.title: OpenRefine
children.description: Free, open-source power tool for working with messy data. Clean, transform, and extend data with web services. Formerly Google Refine. BSD-3-Clause licensed.

children.title: Doccano
children.description: Open-source text annotation tool for machine learning practitioners. Features text classification, sequence labeling, and sequence-to-sequence tasks for sentiment analysis, NER, and summarization. MIT licensed.

children.title: Optuna
children.description: Modern, define-by-run hyperparameter optimization with pruning and visualizations. Extremely popular in 2026.

children.title: AutoGluon
children.description: AWS AutoML toolkit for tabular, image, text, and multimodal data - state-of-the-art with almost zero code.

children.title: FLAML
children.description: Microsoft's fast & lightweight AutoML focused on efficiency and low compute.

children.title: Katib (Kubeflow)
children.description: Kubernetes-native AutoML for hyperparameter tuning, early stopping, and neural architecture search. Framework-agnostic with support for TensorFlow, PyTorch, XGBoost, and custom training operators. Apache 2.0 licensed.

children.title: Streamlit
children.description: The fastest way to build and share data apps. Transform Python scripts into beautiful web applications with minimal code. Widely used for ML model demos, data visualization, and internal tools.

children.title: Gradio
children.description: Build and share delightful machine learning apps, all in Python. The de facto standard for creating interactive ML demos with automatic UI generation from function signatures. Powers thousands of Hugging Face Spaces.

children.title: Marimo
children.description: A reactive notebook for Python — run reproducible experiments, query with SQL, execute as a script, deploy as an app, and version with git. Stored as pure Python. All in a modern, AI-native editor.

children.title: DeepSpeed
children.description: Microsoft's deep learning optimization library for extreme-scale training (ZeRO, offloading, MoE).

children.title: PyTorch Lightning
children.description: High-level wrapper for PyTorch that removes boilerplate and adds best practices.

children.title: fastai
children.description: Deep learning library providing practitioners with high-level components for state-of-the-art results. Built on PyTorch with a focus on usability and transfer learning. Apache 2.0 licensed.

children.title: SHAP
children.description: Game theoretic approach to explain the output of any machine learning model. Industry standard for model interpretability.

children.title: FlashAttention
children.description: Fast exact attention kernels that reduce memory usage and accelerate transformer training and inference.

children.title: ONNX Runtime
children.description: High-performance inference and training for ONNX models across hardware.

children.title: xFormers
children.description: Optimized transformer building blocks and attention operators for PyTorch.

children.title: Hugging Face Accelerate
children.description: Simple API to make training scripts run on any hardware (multi-GPU, TPU, mixed precision) with minimal code changes.

children.title: einops
children.description: Flexible, powerful tensor operations for readable and reliable code. Supports PyTorch, JAX, TensorFlow, NumPy, MLX.

children.title: NVIDIA Apex
children.description: PyTorch extension for mixed precision training and distributed training optimizations. Powers many production deep learning workloads with tools for automatic mixed precision (AMP), distributed data parallel, and fused optimizers. BSD-3-Clause licensed.

children.title: skorch
children.description: scikit-learn compatible neural network library that wraps PyTorch. Seamlessly integrate PyTorch models with scikit-learn pipelines, grid search, and cross-validation.

children.title: Composer
children.description: Supercharge your model training. MosaicML's PyTorch training library with built-in algorithms for efficient training (FSDP, gradient compression, progressive resizing) and seamless distributed training on large-scale clusters. Apache 2.0 licensed.

children.title: PyTorch Ignite
children.description: High-level library for training and evaluating neural networks in PyTorch with an engine, events & handlers system for maximum flexibility. BSD-3-Clause licensed.

children.title: safetensors
children.description: Simple, safe way to store and distribute tensors. Fast, secure alternative to pickle for model serialization.

children.title: torchao
children.description: PyTorch native quantization and sparsity for training and inference. Drop-in optimizations for production deployment.

children.title: torchmetrics
children.description: Machine learning metrics for distributed, scalable PyTorch applications. 80+ metrics with built-in distributed synchronization.

items.title: 1. Core Frameworks & Libraries

items.description: Canonical model-family repositories with useful code, recipes, evaluation tools, or engineering context. This is not a complete model leaderboard; use Hugging Face and model hubs for up-to-date weight discovery.

children.title: GPT-OSS
children.description: OpenAI open-weight model repository with inference examples, recipes, and deployment guidance.

children.title: Mamba
children.description: State Space Model implementation with pretrained checkpoints, architecture code, and research tooling for efficient long-sequence modeling.

children.title: RWKV
children.description: Attention-free language model architecture with linear-time inference, training code, inference examples, and an active open-source ecosystem.

children.title: MiniCPM
children.description: Compact open model family with practical code, deployment notes, and active edge/on-device focus.

children.title: GPT-NeoX
children.description: Large-scale language model training codebase from EleutherAI with distributed training support and historical open-model importance.

children.title: GLM-5
children.description: Open-source mixture-of-experts language model family optimized for long-horizon planning, agentic tasks, and coding. Apache 2.0 licensed.

children.title: openai/CLIP
children.description: Canonical OpenAI contrastive vision-language model codebase with pretrained checkpoints and practical reference implementation for image-text retrieval and classification.

children.title: MiniCPM-V
children.description: Compact vision-language model family with edge-focused deployment examples and strong OCR-oriented use cases.

children.title: OmniParser
children.description: Vision-based GUI parsing model and tooling for computer-use agents.

children.title: OpenCLIP
children.description: Open implementation of CLIP with training code, pretrained models, and zero-shot evaluation tooling.

children.title: NVIDIA Cosmos
children.description: Open platform of world models, tokenizers, and post-training tools designed for physical AI, robotics, and autonomous systems.

children.title: Moondream
children.description: Small vision-language model with practical inference examples for edge and real-time image understanding.

children.title: Depth Anything V2
children.description: Monocular depth-estimation foundation model with practical inference code and broad computer-vision reuse.

children.title: VILA
children.description: NVIDIA vision-language model family with training, evaluation, and deployment materials across edge and datacenter settings.

children.title: Eagle
children.description: NVIDIA multimodal model codebase with open checkpoints and reusable research materials for vision-language and video-language tasks.

children.title: Whisper
children.description: Canonical open speech-to-text model codebase with widespread ecosystem support and many downstream implementations.

children.title: VibeVoice
children.description: Open Frontier Voice AI toolkit spanning speech understanding, generation, and multilingual TTS workflows, with active research and deployment tooling.

children.title: VoxCPM
children.description: Open-sourced tokenizer-free multilingual speech synthesis model with high-quality TTS and style transfer workflows.

children.title: FunASR
children.description: Speech recognition toolkit with pretrained models, streaming support, diarization, VAD, and production-oriented examples.

children.title: NVIDIA NeMo
children.description: Scalable framework and model codebase for speech, language, and multimodal AI with recipes and deployment guidance.

children.title: Sherpa-ONNX
children.description: Complete speech toolkit with ASR, TTS, diarization, source separation, and VAD across embedded and edge environments via ONNX Runtime.

children.title: SpeechBrain
children.description: PyTorch speech toolkit with recipes for ASR, TTS, speaker recognition, and speech enhancement.

children.title: Moonshine
children.description: Open-source on-device voice AI toolkit for low-latency speech-to-text, intent recognition, and text-to-speech.

children.title: Pocket TTS
children.description: Lightweight text-to-speech engine optimized for CPU inference with low latency and streaming support. MIT licensed.

children.title: MOSS-TTS
children.description: Open speech and sound generation family focused on expressive, long-form text-to-speech with streaming and multi-speaker support.

children.title: transcribe.cpp
children.description: C/C++ speech-to-text inference library running 16+ model families on the ggml runtime with GPU acceleration.

items.title: 2. Model Codebases & Model Families

items.description: Inference runtimes, serving systems, and optimization tools for running models locally or in production.

children.title: Ollama
children.description: Dead-simple local LLM runner with a one-line install, model registry, and OpenAI-compatible API.

children.title: llama.cpp
children.description: Pure C/C++ inference engine with GGUF format support. The gold standard for CPU/GPU/Apple Silicon on-device running. Includes llama-server for OpenAI-compatible API. Now at 100K+ stars.

children.title: exo
children.description: Run frontier AI locally by connecting all your devices into an AI cluster. Features automatic device discovery, RDMA over Thunderbolt for 99% latency reduction, topology-aware auto parallel, and tensor parallelism. Uses MLX backend for distributed inference across Apple Silicon devices. Apache 2.0 licensed.

children.title: llmfit
children.description: Terminal tool and TUI that right-sizes LLM models to hardware specs and scores local compatibility across GPU, CPU, and RAM. MIT licensed.

children.title: MLC-LLM
children.description: Deployment engine that compiles and runs LLMs across browsers, mobile devices, and local hardware.

children.title: ds4
children.description: Native inference engine optimized for DeepSeek V4 and GLM models with Metal, CUDA, and ROCm support.

children.title: omlx
children.description: Apple-centric inference server for local-first AI workflows with model management, GPU orchestration, and OpenAI-compatible APIs for self-hosted deployment. Apache 2.0 licensed.

children.title: WebLLM
children.description: High-performance in-browser LLM inference engine. Runs models directly in the browser with WebGPU acceleration.

children.title: KoboldCpp
children.description: User-friendly llama.cpp fork focused on role-playing and creative writing.

children.title: llama-cpp-python
children.description: Official Python bindings for llama.cpp.

children.title: Needle
children.description: Compact 45M-parameter foundation model and 14MB inference engine for tool calling and structured extraction on tiny devices. MIT licensed.

children.title: LiteRT-LM
children.description: Production-ready runtime for deploying LLMs on edge devices with low-latency inference and optimized hardware paths for mobile and embedded platforms.

children.title: LiteRT
children.description: Google's production-ready on-device ML and GenAI deployment framework. Supports Android, iOS, Web, Desktop, and IoT targets with GPU/NPU acceleration via a unified edge-first runtime. Apache 2.0 licensed.

children.title: RamaLama
children.description: Container-centric tool for simplifying local AI model serving. Automatically detects GPUs, pulls optimized container images, and runs models securely in rootless containers with enterprise-grade isolation.

children.title: Foundry Local
children.description: Open-source on-device AI platform covering discovery, model running, sandboxed execution, and evaluation of open models.

children.title: Potato OS
children.description: Linux distribution for fully local AI inference on Raspberry Pi 5 and 4, optimized for running open models at the edge.

children.title: vLLM
children.description: State-of-the-art serving engine with PagedAttention and continuous batching. Currently the fastest production-grade LLM server.

children.title: OmniRoute
children.description: Unified AI gateway and proxy supporting over 230 providers with token compression, automatic failover, and routing strategies. MIT licensed.

children.title: Microsoft BitNet
children.description: Official inference framework for 1-bit LLMs (BitNet b1.58). Enables running large models on CPU with minimal memory footprint. Features custom kernels for ternary weight quantization and efficient matmul operations. MIT licensed.

children.title: SGLang
children.description: Next-gen serving framework with RadixAttention. Powers xAI's production workloads at 100K+ GPUs scale.

children.title: llamafile
children.description: Mozilla's single-file distributable LLM solution. Bundle model weights, inference engine, and runtime into one portable executable that runs on six OSes without installation.

children.title: FreeLLMAPI

items.title: 4. Agentic AI & Multi-Agent Systems

items.description: Retrieval systems, vector databases, embedding models, and related tooling for RAG pipelines.

children.title: Elasticsearch
children.description: Distributed search and analytics engine with native k-NN vector search, hybrid search, and dense vector indexing. Industry-standard for full-text search now with powerful semantic search capabilities. AGPL-3.0/Elastic-2.0 dual licensed.

children.title: Meilisearch
children.description: Lightning-fast search engine API with AI-powered hybrid search. Features typo-tolerant full-text search combined with HNSW-based vector search for semantic retrieval. MIT licensed.

children.title: Milvus
children.description: Scalable cloud-native vector database.

children.title: Faiss
children.description: Similarity search and clustering library for dense vectors with CPU and GPU implementations.

children.title: Qdrant
children.description: High-performance vector search engine in Rust.

children.title: Chroma
children.description: Most popular open-source embedding database.

children.title: Typesense
children.description: Open source alternative to Algolia + Pinecone. Fast, typo-tolerant, in-memory fuzzy search engine with native vector search capabilities. GPL-3.0 licensed.

children.title: pgvector
children.description: PostgreSQL extension for vector similarity search.

children.title: Weaviate
children.description: GraphQL-native vector search engine.

children.title: turbovec
children.description: Rust-native high-performance vector index with Python bindings optimized for fast ANN search and SIMD acceleration on modern CPUs. MIT licensed.

children.title: Tantivy
children.description: Full-text search engine library inspired by Apache Lucene and written in Rust. Powers Quickwit and other production search systems.

children.title: zvec
children.description: Lightweight, lightning-fast, in-process vector database from Alibaba. Built on Proxima (Alibaba's battle-tested vector search engine) for production-grade, low-latency similarity search. Apache 2.0 licensed.

children.title: OpenSearch
children.description: Open-source distributed and RESTful search and analytics suite with native vector search. Enterprise-grade fork of Elasticsearch with k-NN plugin for semantic search at scale.

children.title: Manticore Search
children.description: Easy to use open source fast database for search. Good alternative to Elasticsearch with SQL-like interface and vector search capabilities.

children.title: Quickwit
children.description: Cloud-native search engine for observability. Open-source alternative to Datadog, Elasticsearch, Loki, and Tempo with native vector search support.

children.title: LanceDB
children.description: Serverless vector DB optimized for multimodal data.

children.title: Orama
children.description: Lightweight search engine with full-text, vector, and hybrid search for browser, server, and edge applications.

children.title: Deep Lake
children.description: AI Data Runtime for Agents with serverless PostgreSQL and multimodal datalake. Store and search vectors, images, text, videos, and more with LangChain/LlamaIndex integrations. Used by Intel, Bayer, Yale, and Oxford. Apache 2.0 licensed.

children.title: ParadeDB
children.description: Postgres-native search and analytics engine for full-text, faceted, and hybrid retrieval without moving data out of PostgreSQL.

children.title: sqlite-vec
children.description: A vector search SQLite extension that runs anywhere. Extremely small, "fast enough" vector search written in pure C with no dependencies. Perfect for embedded and edge deployments. MIT/Apache-2.0 dual licensed.

children.title: Vespa
children.description: AI + Data platform with hybrid search (vector + keyword) and real-time indexing at scale. Battle-tested serving billions of queries daily.

children.title: RediSearch
children.description: Full-text, secondary indexing, and vector similarity search for Redis deployments. Useful when retrieval needs low-latency Redis-native search.

children.title: HelixDB
children.description: Graph-vector database for retrieval systems that need relationship traversal alongside semantic search.

children.title: hnswlib
children.description: Header-only C++ library for fast approximate nearest neighbors with Python bindings. Supports CRUD operations and concurrent read/write - unique among ANN libraries. Powers many production vector databases. Apache 2.0 licensed.

children.title: Marqo
children.description: Multimodal vector search for text, image, and structured data. End-to-end indexing and search with built-in embedding models. Apache 2.0 licensed.

children.title: SPTAG (Microsoft)
children.description: Distributed approximate nearest neighbor search library with high-quality vector index build and online serving toolkits. Powers Bing's vector search at trillion-vector scale. MIT licensed.

children.title: USearch
children.description: Fast single-file similarity search & clustering engine for vectors. Smaller and faster than FAISS with 20+ language bindings (C++, Python, JavaScript, Rust, Java, Go, etc.) and support for custom metrics. Apache 2.0 licensed.

children.title: NMSLIB
children.description: Non-Metric Space Library for efficient similarity search in generic non-metric spaces. Comprehensive toolkit for evaluating k-NN methods with support for exotic distance functions. Apache 2.0 licensed.

children.title: pgvectorscale
children.description: PostgreSQL extension for scalable vector search with DiskANN algorithm. Complements pgvector with significantly faster search and higher recall at large scale. PostgreSQL licensed.

children.title: nanoflann
children.description: C++11 header-only library for fast nearest neighbor search with KD-trees. Zero dependencies, single-file integration, and 2-3x faster than FLANN with modern C++. BSD licensed.

children.title: Vearch
children.description: Cloud-native distributed vector database for AI-native applications. Efficient similarity search of embedding vectors with horizontal scaling and real-time indexing. Apache 2.0 licensed.

children.title: DiskANN (Microsoft)
children.description: Graph-structured indices for scalable, fast, fresh and filtered approximate nearest neighbor search. Handles billion-vector datasets on a single node with SSD-based indexing. MIT licensed.

children.title: VectorChord
children.description: Scalable, fast, and disk-friendly vector search in Postgres. Successor to pgvecto.rs with production-grade performance and efficient storage. AGPL-3.0 licensed.

children.title: JVector (DataStax)
children.description: The most advanced embedded vector search engine for Java. DiskANN-based algorithm for billion-scale vector search with efficient memory mapping. Apache 2.0 licensed.

children.title: Vald
children.description: Highly scalable distributed vector search engine. Cloud-native architecture with automatic indexing, horizontal scaling, and multiple ANN algorithm support. Apache 2.0 licensed.

children.title: Apache Solr
children.description: Mature Lucene-based search platform with dense vector search, filtering, faceting, and hybrid retrieval patterns for production search-heavy RAG systems.

children.title: Voyager (Spotify)
children.description: Spotify's next-gen approximate nearest-neighbor search library for Python and Java. Up to 10x faster than Annoy with 4x less memory, designed for production use at billion-vector scale. Apache 2.0 licensed.

children.title: VectorDBBench (Zilliz)
children.description: Industry-standard benchmark suite for vector databases. Test and compare performance of Milvus, Zilliz Cloud, and other vector DBs with your own datasets. MIT licensed.

children.title: NornicDB
children.description: Low-latency graph and vector hybrid retrieval database in Go with Neo4j and Qdrant-compatible drivers.

children.title: BGE (FlagEmbedding)
children.description: BAAI's best-in-class embedding family.

children.title: Text Embeddings Inference (Hugging Face)
children.description: Blazing fast inference solution for text embedding models. High-performance extraction with token-based dynamic batching, Flash Attention, and support for FlagEmbedding, E5, GTE, and more. OpenAI-compatible API with Docker deployment. Apache 2.0 licensed.

children.title: FastEmbed (Qdrant)
children.description: Lightweight, fast Python library for embedding generation with ONNX Runtime. Supports text, sparse (SPLADE), and late-interaction (ColBERT) embeddings without GPU dependencies. Apache 2.0 licensed.

children.title: EmbedAnything
children.description: Minimalist, highly performant multimodal embedding pipeline built in Rust. Memory-safe, modular, and production-ready for text, image, and audio embeddings with seamless vector DB integration. Apache 2.0 licensed.

children.title: MTEB
children.description: Massive Text Embedding Benchmark covering 1000+ languages and diverse tasks. The industry standard for evaluating and comparing embedding models.

children.title: RAGFlow
children.description: Deep-document-understanding RAG engine.

children.title: MinerU
children.description: High-accuracy document parsing for LLM and RAG workflows. Converts PDFs, Word, PPTs, and images into structured Markdown/JSON with VLM+OCR dual engine.

children.title: Docling
children.description: Document processing toolkit for turning PDFs and other files into structured data for GenAI workflows.

children.title: EmbedChain
children.description: Universal memory layer for AI agents. Simple API to create RAG applications over any dataset with support for multiple vector stores, embedding models, and LLM providers. Apache 2.0 licensed.

children.title: Pathway
children.description: Python ETL framework for stream processing, real-time analytics, LLM pipelines, and RAG. Features 350+ connectors with always-in-sync data from SharePoint, Google Drive, S3, Kafka, PostgreSQL and more. BSL 1.1 license (becomes Apache 2.0 after 4 years).

children.title: PrivateGPT
children.description: Private document Q&A project for local and offline RAG workflows where data stays inside the user's environment.

children.title: LlamaIndex
children.description: Full-featured RAG pipeline with advanced indexing.

children.title: Marker
children.description: Fast, accurate PDF-to-markdown converter with table extraction, equation handling, and optional LLM enhancement for RAG pipelines.

children.title: LightRAG
children.description: Graph-based RAG with dual-level retrieval system. Simple and fast with comprehensive knowledge discovery (EMNLP 2025).

children.title: GraphRAG (Microsoft)
children.description: Knowledge-graph-based RAG.

children.title: PageIndex (VectifyAI)
children.description: Vectorless, reasoning-based RAG framework using document index structure. Achieves high accuracy without vector databases through intelligent context engineering and reasoning-based retrieval. MIT licensed.

children.title: FastGPT
children.description: Knowledge-base platform with RAG retrieval, document processing, visual AI workflows, and self-hosted deployment options.

children.title: Haystack
children.description: End-to-end NLP and RAG framework.

children.title: Kotaemon (Cinnamon)
children.description: Open-source RAG-based tool for chatting with your documents. Hybrid RAG pipeline with full-text and vector retriever, re-ranking, and multi-modal capabilities. Clean Gradio-based UI with support for local and API-based LLMs. Apache 2.0 licensed.

children.title: RAG-Anything
children.description: All-in-One Multimodal RAG system for seamless processing of text, images, tables, and equations. Built on LightRAG.

children.title: MaxKB
children.description: Self-hostable knowledge-base and agent platform for document ingestion, RAG pipelines, and enterprise assistant workflows.

children.title: localGPT
children.description: Local document-chat project for private, on-device Q&A over files without sending data to external APIs.

children.title: DB-GPT
children.description: Self-hosted AI data assistant for private knowledge, database-aware conversations, and data-heavy RAG workflows.

children.title: DocsGPT
children.description: Private AI platform for building intelligent agents and assistants with enterprise search. Features Agent Builder, deep research tools, multi-format document analysis, and multi-model support. MIT licensed.

children.title: SurfSense
children.description: Privacy-focused NotebookLM-style workspace for teams to search, organize, and query knowledge with self-hosted RAG.

children.title: Unstructured
children.description: Best-in-class document preprocessing.

children.title: llmware
children.description: Unified framework for building enterprise RAG pipelines with small, specialized models. Optimized for AI PC and local deployment with 300+ models in catalog. Apache 2.0 licensed.

children.title: LangChain4j
children.description: Java library for integrating LLMs into Java applications. Implements RAG, tool calling (including MCP support), and agents with seamless integration into enterprise Java frameworks like Spring Boot. Apache 2.0 licensed.

children.title: txtai
children.description: All-in-one AI framework for semantic search, LLM orchestration and language model workflows. Embeddings database with customizable pipelines.

children.title: Reader (Jina AI)
children.description: Convert any URL to LLM-friendly input with a simple prefix (r.jina.ai). Free service that extracts article content, removes clutter, and returns clean Markdown for RAG and agentic workflows. Apache 2.0 licensed.

children.title: UltraRAG (OpenBMB)
children.description: First lightweight RAG framework based on Model Context Protocol (MCP) architecture. Low-code RAG pipeline builder with comprehensive evaluation system and DeepResearch capabilities. From Tsinghua THUNLP, NEUIR, OpenBMB, and AI9stars. Apache 2.0 licensed.

children.title: Chonkie
children.description: Lightweight document chunking library for fast, efficient RAG pipelines. Memory-safe with multiple chunking strategies (semantic, token, recursive) and direct vector DB integration. MIT licensed.

children.title: Infinity (AI Database)
children.description: AI-native database built for LLM applications with incredibly fast hybrid search of dense vector, sparse vector, tensor (multi-vector), and full-text. Powers RAGFlow's document engine. Apache 2.0 licensed.

children.title: Semantic Router
children.description: Superfast AI decision-making layer for LLMs and agents. Uses semantic vector space to route requests using semantic meaning rather than waiting for slow LLM generations. Cuts routing time from seconds to milliseconds. MIT licensed.

children.title: Morphik
children.description: Open-source multimodal RAG framework for building AI apps over private knowledge. Handles text, images, and documents with built-in embedding generation and vector search. MIT licensed.

children.title: FlashRAG
children.description: Efficient toolkit for RAG research with 40+ retrieval and reranking models, 20+ benchmark datasets, and optimized evaluation pipelines (WWW 2025 Resource). MIT licensed.

children.title: AutoFlow
children.description: Graph RAG-based conversational knowledge base tool built on TiDB Vector and LlamaIndex. Features Perplexity-style search with built-in website crawler. Apache 2.0 licensed.

children.title: Infinity (Embeddings Server)
children.description: High-throughput, low-latency serving engine for text-embeddings, reranking, CLIP, and ColPali. OpenAI-compatible API.

children.title: ColPali / ColQwen
children.description: Vision-language models for document retrieval.

children.title: Kernel Memory (Microsoft)
children.description: Memory solution for users, teams, and applications. RAG pipelines with document ingestion, vector indexing, and natural language querying with citations. Supports multiple LLM providers and vector stores. MIT licensed.

children.title: Neurite
children.description: Fractal Graph-of-Thought mind-mapping for AI agents, web-links, notes, and code. Rhizomatic workspace blending chaos theory, graph theory, and fractal logic for creative thinking and RAG workflows. MIT licensed.

children.title: RAGLite (Superlinear)
children.description: Python toolkit for RAG with DuckDB or PostgreSQL. Lightweight, efficient retrieval-augmented generation without heavy dependencies. MPL 2.0 licensed.

children.title: GPT-RAG (Azure)
children.description: Enterprise RAG pattern for Azure OpenAI at scale. Secure, production-ready architecture using Azure Cognitive Search and Azure OpenAI LLMs for ChatGPT-style Q&A experiences. MIT licensed.

children.title: Beever Atlas
children.description: Open-source LLM knowledge base combining Neo4j knowledge graph with Weaviate vector DB for graph-based RAG. Native MCP server, team chat ingestion (Slack, Discord, Teams, Telegram), and BYO LLM via LiteLLM. Apache 2.0 licensed.

children.title: VidXP
children.description: Local-first multimodal video indexing and semantic search toolkit with transcript extraction, embeddings, scene-aware search. Can be used as a CLI, API and MCP.

children.title: PieKBS
children.description: Local-first knowledge search engine for agents with FTS5 full-text search and graph-based document expansion via citation/support/wiki links. Pure Go, no embedding required.

children.title: Graphiti
children.description: Build real-time temporal knowledge graphs for AI agents. Tracks how facts change over time with provenance to source data. Supports prescribed and learned ontology for evolving real-world data. Apache 2.0 licensed.

children.title: Semantica
children.description: Graph-native infrastructure for context management, bi-temporal knowledge graphs, GraphRAG document chunking, and explainable AI reasoning. MIT licensed.

children.title: Code-Graph-RAG
children.description: Multi-language codebase RAG framework using Tree-sitter and Memgraph knowledge graphs to query, edit, and optimize codebases with AI. MIT licensed.

children.title: Firecrawl
children.description: Web Data API for AI - search, scrape, and interact with the web at scale. Clean markdown/JSON output with proxy rotation and JS-blocking handled automatically.

children.title: Crawl4AI
children.description: LLM-friendly web crawler that turns websites into clean Markdown for RAG and agentic workflows.

children.title: Scrapling
children.description: Adaptive web scraping and crawling framework for robust structured extraction from pages to large-scale pipelines.

children.title: Lightpanda
children.description: Machine-first headless browser in Zig; rendering-free and ultra-lightweight for AI agent browsing.

children.title: Paperless-AI
children.description: Automated document analyzer for Paperless-ngx with RAG-powered semantic search across your document archive.

children.title: wigolo
children.description: Local-first web intelligence and Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for web search, crawling, and structured data extraction. AGPL-3.0 licensed.

children.title: invisible-playwright
children.description: Playwright wrapper for a stealth-patched Firefox 150 binary. Drop-in Browser object for AI agents that need to ingest web data from sites with anti-bot guardrails (reCAPTCHA, FingerprintPro, Cloudflare). Spoofing happens in C++ source, not via JS overrides.
